ai_summary: Abbott India Limited reported strong financial performance for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, with revenue from operations increasing to Rs. 1,813.68 crores (+4.33% year-on-year) and net profit rising to Rs. 428.52 crores (+17.13% year-on-year). This indicates robust operational efficiency and healthy market demand for its pharmaceutical products, further reflected in a strong Earnings Per Share of Rs. 201.66. The unaudited results were subjected to a limited review by statutory auditors, who issued a clean report with no qualifications, indicating no material red flags.
